brief:
Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qasem rejected Israeli claims that the movement violated a ceasefire agreement and resumed military operations, according to Shehab Wire. Qasem characterized the accusations as propaganda designed to justify Israeli occupation violations and incite against Hamas, dismissing them as part of a broader Israeli campaign rather than credible allegations.

The Hamas spokesman did not provide specific details about the disputed ceasefire terms or address particular claims regarding military activities. His statement came as tensions remained high over the implementation and enforcement of agreements between the Israeli military and Palestinian resistance factions.

title: Hamas spokesman denies Israeli ceasefire breach allegations as propaganda.
